title: core-unit-bioinformatics/workflow-nxf-sequencing-qc pipeline parameters
description: Quality control for short-read sequencing runs (panels, exomes, genomes).

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_inputs.description: Path to file specifying the multiqc input directories. File should have header "paths".

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

multiqc_report_name.description: File name of the MultiQC report, without `.html`, e.g. the run ID. The report is written to `multiqc/<name>.html`, its data to `multiqc/<name>_data/` and its plots to `multiqc/<name>_plots/`.
multiqc_report_name.help_text: Allowed characters: `A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `_`, `-`; the name must start with a letter or digit and must not end in `.html`. If not set, MultiQC names the report `multiqc_report.html`, or `<title>_multiqc_report.html` with `--multiqc_title`.

fingerprintcheck_options.title: Fingerprint check options
fingerprintcheck_options.description: Options for the Picard fingerprint check of this run's samples and the fingerprint database of previous runs.

enable_fingerprintcheck.description: Enable the fingerprint check (Picard CrosscheckFingerprints and the fingerprint database).
enable_fingerprintcheck.help_text: When enabled, every samplesheet row needs a `runid` and either a `bam` or, with `--align_reads_for_fingerprint`, FASTQ files. Requires `--fingerprint_haplotype_map` and `--fasta`.

fingerprint_haplotype_map.description: Path to the Picard haplotype map (text format) used for the fingerprints.
fingerprint_haplotype_map.help_text: Required when `--enable_fingerprintcheck` is set. Must be the text format with `@SQ` header lines (e.g. `Homo_sapiens_assembly38.haplotype_database.txt`); haplotype maps in VCF format are not supported. Use the same map for all runs of one fingerprint database.

fingerprint_allow_duplicate_reads.description: Allow duplicate reads in CrosscheckFingerprints of this run's BAMs (heatmap).

align_reads_for_fingerprint.description: Align the FASTQ files of samples without BAM with bwa-mem2 for the fingerprint check.
align_reads_for_fingerprint.help_text: Off by default. Without it, every samplesheet row needs a `bam`. The aligned BAMs are only used for fingerprinting and are not published. Uses `--bwamem2_index`, or builds the index from `--fasta` (slow and memory-intensive for a human genome).

fingerprint_database.description: Fingerprint database of previous exomeqc runs (`fingerprintcheck/database/exomeqc_fingerprint_database_<YYYYMMDD-hhmmss>.vcf.gz`).
fingerprint_database.help_text: Optional. Plain VCF, gzip or bgzip; an index is not needed (a new one is made). Checked against `--fingerprint_haplotype_map` first; a database of another haplotype map or reference stops the run with an ERROR. WARNING: fingerprints with the same sample AND run ID (`<sample>@<runid>`) as a sample of this run are dropped and replaced by the new ones. This run is compared with the remaining fingerprints, then added to them; the result is written as the new database. The given file is not modified.

fingerprint_database_lod_threshold.description: LOD threshold T for comparisons with the fingerprint database: match if LOD >= T, mismatch if LOD <= -T, inconclusive in between.
fingerprint_database_lod_threshold.help_text: A LOD of N means the two fingerprints are 10^N times more likely to come from the same individual than from different ones. Also used for the fingerprint of each sample: SUITABLE if its self LOD (the sample's BAM compared with itself) is >= T, else INSUFFICIENT.

fingerprint_qc_min_base_quality.description: Fingerprint QC: minimum base quality of a base to count for the depth (FPDP), the allele depths and the contamination estimate.
fingerprint_qc_min_base_quality.help_text: Bases below are left out. Each read name counts once per haplotype site. Stored in the fingerprint database as MinBaseQuality.

fingerprint_qc_min_mapping_quality.description: Fingerprint QC: minimum mapping quality of a read to count at a haplotype site.
fingerprint_qc_min_mapping_quality.help_text: Reads below are left out of the depth (FPDP) and the mean base quality (FPBQ). Stored in the fingerprint database as MinMappingQuality.

fingerprint_qc_min_site_depth.description: Fingerprint QC: minimum depth (FPDP) of a haplotype site to pass.
fingerprint_qc_min_site_depth.help_text: FPDP counts the bases with base and mapping quality at least the thresholds above. Sites below get the filter FpLowDepth and flat genotype likelihoods (PL 0,0,0), so they do not contribute to fingerprint comparisons. Stored as MinSiteDepth.

fingerprint_qc_min_site_mean_base_qualit.description: Fingerprint QC: minimum mean base quality (FPBQ) of a haplotype site to pass.
fingerprint_qc_min_site_mean_base_qualit.help_text: FPBQ is the mean base quality of all bases with mapping quality at least --fingerprint_qc_min_mapping_quality. Sites below get the filter FpLowBaseQuality and flat genotype likelihoods. Stored as MinSiteMeanBaseQuality.

fingerprint_qc_min_fraction_passing_site.description: Fingerprint QC: minimum fraction of haplotype sites that pass for the sample to pass.
fingerprint_qc_min_fraction_passing_site.help_text: Set it according to the haplotype map: with a map of SNPs outside the targets of the exome kit, few sites reach the depth. Stored as MinFractionPassingSites.

fingerprint_qc_contamination_check.description: Fingerprint QC: estimate the contamination of each sample and fail samples above --fingerprint_qc_max_contamination.
fingerprint_qc_contamination_check.help_text: Off by default. The estimate uses the model of VerifyBamID FREEMIX, which assumes a diploid, copy-neutral sample; it was shown to overestimate the contamination of most tumour samples, because copy-number-driven allelic imbalance looks like contamination (Bergmann et al. 2016, Conpair). Use it only for germline (normal) samples. When off, the contamination is recorded as not checked (Contamination=., MaxContamination=.).

fingerprint_qc_max_contamination.description: Fingerprint QC: maximum estimated contamination (fraction of reads from another person) for the sample to pass; only used with --fingerprint_qc_contamination_check.
fingerprint_qc_max_contamination.help_text: Estimated by maximum likelihood from the high-quality bases of the passing sites and the allele frequencies (MAF) of the haplotype map (model of VerifyBamID FREEMIX). Not suited for tumour samples. Stored as MaxContamination.

fastqscreen_options.title: FastQ Screen options
fastqscreen_options.description: Options for optional FastQ Screen contamination screening.

enable_fastqscreen.description: Enable FastQ Screen analysis for input FASTQ files.
enable_fastqscreen.help_text: Requires `--fastqscreen_database` to point to a FastQ Screen database directory containing `fastq_screen.conf`.

fastqscreen_database.description: Path to the FastQ Screen database: a directory or a .tar.gz archive of it.
fastqscreen_database.help_text: Directory (or .tar.gz of the directory) containing `fastq_screen.conf` and the Bowtie2 indices. DATABASE paths in `fastq_screen.conf` must be absolute or relative to the parent of the database directory (`<database_dir_name>/<genome>/<index_prefix>`), as written by FastQ Screen's `--get_genomes` and nf-core `fastqscreen/buildfromindex`. An archive is unpacked into a directory named like the archive without `.tar.gz`.

fastqscreen_subset.description: Number of reads to subset for fastqscreen analysis. Paired-end should be twice as much.

vaf_histogram_options.title: VAF histogram options
vaf_histogram_options.description: Options for the variant allele fraction (VAF) histogram in the MultiQC report.

enable_vaf_histogram.description: Add a histogram of the variant allele fractions per sample to the MultiQC report.
enable_vaf_histogram.help_text: Off by default. If set, reads the VCF of every sample with a `vcf` in the samplesheet (any variant caller). The pipeline stops if no sample has a `vcf`.

vaf_histogram_bin_width.description: Width of the VAF bins, a fraction in (0, 1], e.g. 0.05 for 5 % bins.
vaf_histogram_bin_width.help_text: Bins are [start, end); the last bin includes VAF 1.0 and is cut at 1 if 1 is not a multiple of the width.

vaf_histogram_allele_fraction.description: Source of the VAF: `FORMAT_AF` (FORMAT/AF), `FORMAT_AD` (FORMAT/AD[alt] / FORMAT/DP) or `auto` (FORMAT_AF if the VCF header declares FORMAT/AF, else FORMAT_AD).
vaf_histogram_allele_fraction.help_text: As `--allele_fraction` of cio-abcd/variantinterpretation, plus `auto`, which chooses per VCF from its header. The pipeline stops if a VCF lacks the needed FORMAT fields or a counted variant has no value.

vaf_histogram_sample_regex.description: Count only VCF columns whose sample name matches this regular expression (Python syntax), e.g. `-T$` for the tumor column of a tumor/normal VCF. Default: all columns.
vaf_histogram_sample_regex.help_text: The pipeline stops if the regex matches no column of a VCF. With one counted column the histogram is named after the samplesheet sample, with several `<sample>_<column>`. Must not contain a single quote.

vaf_histogram_include_filtered.description: Also count variants whose FILTER is not PASS or `.`. Default: only PASS variants and variants with FILTER `.` (no filters applied).

summary_options.title: Report summary options
summary_options.description: Compact per-case summary (CNV QC, purity, ploidy, TMB, MSI, HRD) at the top of the MultiQC report. Needs --dragen_dirs.

enable_summary.description: Add the summary section to the top of the MultiQC report.

summary_tmb_high.description: Highlight TMB (mut/Mb) at or above this value. Unset: no highlighting.

summary_msi_high.description: Highlight MSI (% unstable sites, DRAGEN PercentageUnstableSites) at or above this value. Unset: no highlighting.

summary_hrd_high.description: Highlight HRD sum (LOH + TAI + LST) at or above this value. Unset: no highlighting.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.description: Path to the reference FASTA the BAMs are aligned to.
fasta.help_text: Required with `--enable_fingerprintcheck` (Picard ExtractFingerprint). Must be uncompressed. Also used for the alignment with `--align_reads_for_fingerprint`.

fasta_fai.description: Path to the samtools index (.fai) of `--fasta`. Created if not given.

fasta_dict.description: Path to the sequence dictionary (.dict) of `--fasta`. Created if not given.

bwamem2_index.description: Path to the bwa-mem2 index directory of `--fasta` (used with `--align_reads_for_fingerprint`). Built if not given.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

enable_cnvqc.description: Run the DRAGEN CNV QC (bin/analyze_cnv_metrics.R) on the DRAGEN output in --dragen_dirs.

dragen_dirs.description: Directory with the DRAGEN output of all samples, searched recursively for the CNV files.

pmad_max.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if PMAD (cnv_metrics.csv) is above this value. Not checked if unset.

coverage_mad_max.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if Coverage MAD (cnv_metrics.csv) is above this value. Not checked if unset.

outlier_baf_fraction_max.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if OutlierBafFraction (cnv_metrics.csv) is above this value. Not checked if unset.

diploid_coverage_min.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if DiploidCoverage (CNV VCF header) is below this value. Not checked if unset.

purity_min.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if EstimatedTumorPurity (CNV VCF header) is below this value. A fraction in [0, 1], e.g. 0.4 for 40 %. Not checked if unset.

purity_max.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if EstimatedTumorPurity (CNV VCF header) is above this value. A fraction in [0, 1]. Not checked if unset.

ploidy_min.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if OverallPloidy (CNV VCF header) is below this value. Not checked if unset.

ploidy_max.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if OverallPloidy (CNV VCF header) is above this value. Not checked if unset.

post_norm_sigma_max.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if Post-Normalization Bin Count Sigma (cnv_metrics.csv) is above this value. Not checked if unset.

num_segments_max.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if the Number of segments (cnv_metrics.csv) is above this value. Not checked if unset.

filtered_records_relative_max.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if the percentage of filtered records (cnv_metrics.csv) is above this value. Not checked if unset.

homozygosity_index_max.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if HomozygosityIndex (CNV VCF header) is above this value. Not checked if unset.

total_excluded_bp_max.description: CNV QC: fail a sample if the total length of the excluded intervals (*.cnv.excluded_intervals.bed.gz, in bp) is above this value. Not checked if unset.
